chunks: Let them profit by the world (while they may): In the end they will come back to Us. Then We shall make them taste severe punishment for having denied (the truth).
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who enjoy worldly life while denying the truth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Yunus underscores the transient nature of dunya as a test rather than a reward, emphasizing that the 'temporary enjoyment' is a divine concession before the inevitable return to Allah. It highlights the causal link between their persistent kufr (disbelief) and the severity of the punishment, reflecting the justice of God who does not punish without cause. This serves as a reminder for believers to prioritize the hereafter over fleeting worldly gains.
